method: Threshold-only calibration. Historical scores and 80 new calibration cases guide selection; 40 additional validation cases and six repeated user car regressions assess the profile. One result per case except explicitly repeated car prompts; validation examples were inspected during analysis, not a blinded study. Jev and Clef-flash profiles unchanged. Scores are not calibrated probabilities. Recorded cases do not guarantee future safety or approvals.
